purpose: Teach: 長田/井口/小西/宮澤/田辺/塩川/児玉/本間

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、長田刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: The way Detective Nagata handled the crime scene was really commendable.
lines.style: Warm, acknowledging tone. Respectful but conversational — not flattering. Even pace, steady eye contact. A genuine compliment, not ceremonial.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人井口氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: You're being very thorough with the witness statements from Iguchi.
lines.style: Steady, observational. Light nod in the voice — noticing good work without overdoing it. Calm pace, no urgency. Recognition without pressure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者小西氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: I can see how carefully you're handling the victim's family situation.
lines.style: Gentle sincerity. Quieter than the previous lines — this matters more. Acknowledging something difficult handled well. Slower pace, softer attack.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者宮澤氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: You've organized the witness testimony from Miyazawa very methodically.
lines.style: Approving, professional. Clear diction on 'methodically.' Straightforward delivery — noting competence without fuss. Even tempo, firm but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者田辺の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: Verifying Tanabe's background thoroughly shows good investigative instinct.
lines.style: Direct praise wrapped in conversational tone. Slight emphasis on 'thoroughly.' Warm undertone — defending the approach as sound. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の鑑識塩川主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: Working with forensics lead Shiokawa to check the scene was the right call.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact agreement. Light, confident — affirming a decision already made. No second-guessing. Even pace, slightly shorter breaths between clauses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士児玉様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: Getting Kodama's psychological perspective was smart thinking.
lines.style: Approving, easy. Brief and genuine — not over-explaining. Warm tone, quick pace on this one. A small nod of recognition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の本間様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: You're coordinating well with prosecutor Honma on the pre-trial discussions.
lines.style: Warm but careful — this involves another agency. Slightly more formal than previous lines but still close. Steady pace, respectful. Recognition of collaborative work.
